operation: read-only local ignored SQLite custody inventory
digest_encoding: SHA256 over ordered full rows; column header and each typed compact UTF-8 JSON row prefixed by uint64 big-endian byte length; SQL text strings retained exactly; real values float.hex; blob values hex; no values dumped
scope_limit: All table names/counts/schema hashes inventoried. Entire rows compared only for explicitly listed factual/source-bearing tables including inline source and all/nonexample rows. Excluded geographic/derived/archive tables have counts only; equal counts do not establish equal contents. No comparison with remote/provider databases or tracked import files; source preservation necessity beyond this scope is not inferred.
